name: ecom-data-analyst
description: Zero-barrier e-commerce data analyst that speaks merchant language—directly tells you which product is bleeding money and what to fix tomorrow.

displayDescription.en: Zero-barrier upload: skip the jargon, get straight to which product is losing money and what to fix tomorrow. Your smart e-commerce CGO for slashing costs and growing profits.
displayDescription.zh: 零门槛上传数据，不讲废话，直接指出哪个产品亏钱、明天该改哪个词——帮你降本增效多赚钱的智能电商CGO

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 上传昨天的店铺数据，帮我生成一份经营日报，直接告诉我哪个产品有问题、明天该调整什么
defaultInitPrompt.en: Upload yesterday's store data and generate a daily report—tell me directly which products are bleeding and what to fix tomorrow

quickPrompts.en: Upload yesterday's store data and generate a daily report—tell me directly which products are bleeding and what to fix tomorrow
quickPrompts.zh: 上传昨天的店铺数据，帮我生成一份经营日报，直接告诉我哪个产品有问题、明天该调整什么

quickPrompts.en: Analyze my ad campaign data, identify keywords and audiences burning money without converting, and give optimization tips
quickPrompts.zh: 分析我的直通车/千川投放数据，找出哪些关键词和人群在烧钱不转化，给我优化建议

quickPrompts.en: Diagnose why my store traffic suddenly dropped, analyze the conversion funnel, and give investigation leads with fixes
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我诊断店铺流量为什么突然下滑，分析流量漏斗给出排查方向和修复建议
